predecessors.name: Angevin Empire
predecessors.text: Poitou, held 'In personal union with the Kingdom of England; (1154-1205)' (infobox)

successors.name: Kingdom of France
successors.text: 'On Alfonso's death in 1271, Auvergne, along with the County of Toulouse, Poitou and the Comtat Venaissin ... reverted to the royal domain'

ledger.x: 1205: Philip II Augustus conquers Poitou from the English crown.
1225: Louis VIII grants Poitou to his third son Alfonso (Alphonse of Poitiers), who holds it as an apanage; same state, same colour.
1271: Alphonse dies and Poitou reverts to the royal domain.

wars.name: Philip II's conquest of Poitou
wars.outcome: Philip II declared Poitou a confiscated fief and conquered it in 1205; the English crown lost the county.

certainty.note: No treaty line or survey on the pages opened; the extent is the page's three sub-regions and the bordering counties it names, drawn as a soft feudal frontier.
